latest.title: Open a new store: plan it, open it, and watch it earn the investment back
latest.summary: Expansion has a new view, Open a store. Pick a type from the neighbourhoods with the most demand, from any type, or from a Demand cell's new Open a store here, then pick the building in Find a location, fixed to that type. The board lists everything a fully outfitted store of that type needs in that building: what the type requires to open, an item for each customer demand, enough tills for the building's capacity and shelving copied from your own store of the same layout, with the installation firm's price or, for self-installation, a shopping list by furniture store on the map, and the deposit. It then estimates the profit a day from the game's own rules for customers, prices, demand and wages, with the best marketing mix, and shows how many days it takes to earn the investment back, as a range, after tax, against what your own stores of that type earn, and with an optional bank loan. Offices are estimated too; cinemas and theatres show the investment only. A checklist then follows the store until it opens, ticking itself from the save: the lease, furniture, staff for the opening hours, uniforms, customer demands, marketing and logistics, with buttons to staff the store, assign uniforms and set the cheapest marketing mix through the game link. Once the store trades, the plan compares itself with it: the investment, the profit a day and the first days against the plan, the share paid back, the day it breaks even, and any loan it was planned with. Your plans are kept per character, opened stores included. Businesses › Results also has a Payback column: for each shop, office and chain, the day its setup was earned back or how many days are still to go, with the same line on a business's own page.
